hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.md ]]; then root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || dirname "$f"); output=$(cd "$root" && markdownlint "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg o "$output" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("markdownlint issues in "+$f+":\n"+$o)}}'; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
